diagnoses.explanation: The behavioral contract incorrectly prohibited publishing the returned attempt handle after reentrant startup. The public source explicitly returns the cleanup handle even when the visit became non-current, while the README calls it a “returned cleanup handle” and requires existing navigation and cleanup behavior to remain unchanged. The actual barrier is that the superseded attempt must not be installed as the visit's active handle or receive a queued notice; it is still returned after being cancelled. The previous candidate follows that public behavior and also places listen before start, assigns freshness at packet observation, suppresses stale panel paints, preserves audit delivery, and leaves Telemetry unchanged. The failed acceptance verdict has no stated cause, so it cannot establish a separate implementation gap.
